proxy.help: Telegram blocked where you are? Keep your VPN client (v2rayN, Nekoray…) on "Set system proxy" and leave this on System. Node ignores the OS proxy, so the app routes every request through Chromium, which does not.
publish.title: Publish options
publish.topicIdHelp: message_thread_id — a topic of a forum supergroup
publish.dmTopicIdHelp: direct_messages_topic_id — required when the chat is a direct-messages chat
publish.replyToHelp: The sent message quotes that message
publish.businessHelp: business_connection_id — send on behalf of a connected business account
publish.appliedTo: Applied to sending; the editor view shows what leaves the app
send.skipEntitiesHelp: Sends skip_entity_detection: links, hashtags and phone numbers are left as plain text
settings.businessIdHelp: Only for Telegram's *interactive* checklist, which a bot may send only on behalf of a connected business account, in a private chat. Leave it empty: a checklist still travels inside the message, with real checkboxes, in any chat.
settings.security: The token is encrypted with the OS keychain and never reaches this window.

toast.checklist.taskChars: A task is too long — Telegram allows 100 characters
toast.checklist.tasks: Too many tasks — a checklist holds 30
toast.checklistDoneIgnored: Ticked tasks are sent unticked — Telegram cannot send a task already done
toast.checklistPrivateOnly: Checklist sent inside the message — the interactive one needs a private chat
toast.configureToken: Add your bot token in Settings
toast.draftPrivateOnly: Drafts only work in private chats — use a numeric chat ID
toast.draftNoMedia: Drafts cannot carry media — Telegram accepts no file or URL uploads in a streamed draft; send normally or drop the media
toast.invalidId: Enter a numeric Telegram user ID
toast.invalidTime: Enter a Unix timestamp or a parseable date
toast.limit.media: Too much media — Telegram allows 50 files
toast.limit.nesting: Nested too deep — Telegram allows 16 levels of formatting and blocks
toast.needEditId: Add the message ID to edit in Settings
toast.mediaPickFailed: No suitable file could be added
toast.setChatId: Add a chat ID in Settings
toast.thinkingDropped: The thinking placeholder rides drafts only — it was left out of this message
toast.unsafeUrl: That URL scheme is not allowed
toast.warn.webAppPrivate: Web App buttons only work in private chats - a non-private chat will reject or hide them
toast.warn.businessApp: Web App buttons cannot be used for messages sent on behalf of a business account
toast.warn.businessInline: Inline-query buttons are not supported on behalf of a business account or in direct-messages chats
toast.warn.effectPrivate: Message effects are available in private chats only
toast.warn.loginurl: A Login URL button must be whitelisted with @BotFather or it will not log anyone in
toast.warn.inlineQuery: Inline-query buttons need a bot that has inline mode enabled and support the chosen chat scope
